name: @client-platform/example-base-host
description: Real bundleable base-host project for the Metro peel pipeline (#141 + #141b P1 real mode). NOT a runnable app — feeds `scripts/pack-base-peel.mjs --real`. The RN toolchain (react, react-native, @react-native-community/cli) is intentionally NOT installed here; the pack script invokes `node <tiangong-host>/node_modules/react-native/cli.js` so the toolchain lives in one place.
